title: Entanglement Measure Response to Modular Flow and Chiral Topological Phases
abstract_summary: Investigates response of entanglement measures to real-time dynamics driven by modular flow (modular Hamiltonian). Proposes generalization of the Renyi modular commutator. Connects to chiral topological phases.
relevance_reason: Modular flow as a driver of entanglement dynamics is directly related to our holographic transport protocol — the boundary excitation in our transport undergoes modular flow. The modular commutator generalization could provide new observables.
connection_to_project: Our transport protocol perturbs boundary with Y coupling and observes Y response. Modular flow generates the entanglement flow in holography. This paper's modular commutator could be used to diagnose holographic transport efficiency.
